answer: Fragmented-source activation prices out clone farms. A fresh identity requesting activation must assemble its 10,000 POA bond from at least 25 distinct wallets, each contributing 500 POA or less, and no source may back a second bond for 90 epochs. Cost per fake identity: 10,000 POA locked in the oasis escrow plus 25 fresh wallets, so a hundred clones strand 2,500 wallets and 1,000,000 POA, while an honest voyager draws from one garden of accounts tended for years.
